rationale: Every print, program, CAD/CAM file in JM Die's 24,545-file corpus becomes structured training data. Per-domain matcher engines propose 'this new job looks like these 5 we've already shipped — start from that template.' The taptite-electrode Excel macro at 'JM DIE/Automated Program_Corrected 5-25.xlsm' is bridged as a READ-ONLY first-class asset (parsed-snapshot path for MS0; live-Excel COM deferred to v2). Historical S/F values treated as DATA not GROUND TRUTH per feedback_box_programs_amateur — physics-derived recommendations win on disagreement.
